bias.en: Bearish · lost $94.5, testing the July low
bias.zh: 偏空 · 失守 $94.5，测试 7 月低点

read.en: Intel fell 5.8% on Oct 16 to $89.85 and is down 14% in five sessions. It is below its 5-day ($97.5), 10-day ($104.1), 30-day ($109.1) and falling 100-day ($107.1) averages, and above the 200-day ($84.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 5 and is below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 5 ($109.3), and RSI is 31.
read.zh: 英特尔 10月16日下跌 5.8%，收于 $89.85，五个交易日累计下跌 14%。股价位于 5 日（$97.5）、10 日（$104.1）、30 日（$109.1）和下行的 100 日均线（$107.1）下方，仍在 200 日均线（$84.6）之上。MACD 自 10月5日起位于信号线及零轴下方，抛物线 SAR 自 10月5日起看空（$109.3），RSI 为 31。

read.en: The $94.5 September low broke on the close; the day's low of $89.19 undercut the Jul 17 low ($89.6), but the close held just above it. Resistance is $94.5, then $97.5–98.3 (5-day average, June pivot) and $104 (10-day). Support is $89.2–89.6, then $85 (Aug 24 low, 200-day) and $81.8 (Jul 29 low). A close below $89.2 would open $85.
read.zh: $94.5 的 9月低点收盘失守；当日低点 $89.19 跌破 7月17日低点（$89.6），但收盘守在其上方一线。阻力为 $94.5，其次 $97.5–98.3（5 日均线、6月转折点）和 $104（10 日均线）。支撑为 $89.2–89.6，其次 $85（8月24日低点、200 日均线）和 $81.8（7月29日低点）。若收盘跌破 $89.2，下一目标看 $85。

r.en: September low, now resistance; Oct 15 close $95.4
r.zh: 9月低点，转为阻力；10月15日收盘价 $95.4
